analysis: locked-registry descriptive results for the paper window

supersession.reason: This file freezes the final paper window at 2014-05-01 through 2026-04-30 (observed through 2026-04-09).

scope_A_workload_for_Table3_Figure4.definition: All dated canonical examinations in the paper window; repeat examinations retained.

capacity_assumption.interpretation: scenario-based workload-to-capacity ratio, not observed turnaround time
capacity_assumption.partial_year_policy: For 2014 May-Dec and 2026 Jan-Apr (April observed through day 9), lambda=n/calendar months exposed and rho=lambda/(2*22); complete years 2015-2025 are algebraically rho=n/528.

scope_B_patient_first_main11_for_Table1_.definition: Earliest canonical examination per patient within the paper window, then restricted to the prespecified main 11 classes.

eligible_registry_cohort.note: This is the registry-defined task cohort. Only age and sex originate directly from the registry.

linkage_audit.publication_caveat: Fallback links (all methods other than exact_stem) require a manually audited linkage sample before inferential publication use.

nine_feature_missingness.interpretation: Use the primary linked-cohort values for model/ablation reporting; the secondary table shows the full 8,208-patient registry task and treats unlinked morphometry as missing.

pairwise_spearman_available_case.scope: linked model cohort (n=7,754), pairwise complete, no imputation

scope_B_patient_first_main11_for_Table1_.available_case_policy: No imputation for descriptive statistics or correlations; every cell reports its own n.

feature_definitions.sex_binary: M=1, F=0; other/missing imputed within fold
feature_definitions.sclerosis_rate: (explicit global + segmental sclerotic counts) / TEM glomerulus count
feature_definitions.gbm_thickness_nm: reported single value or range midpoint, normalized to nm

methodological_boundaries: Disease labels are report-derived and are not an independent diagnostic gold standard.
Fallback links require a blinded manual linkage audit before inferential publication use.
Morphometry parsers have not undergone a prespecified field-level manual validation study.
GBM thickness and spike presence have severe missingness and require available-case interpretation.
Calendar-year report-template drift limits unadjusted cross-year morphometry comparisons.
Capacity rho is an assumption-dependent scenario ratio and is not observed turnaround time or proof of understaffing.
